text:
Sam K.: FYI customer ACME reported sustained 5xx + timeouts on hosted inference since ~09:40 UTC. Support escalated — logs show gateway 502/504 and some auth 401 spikes.
Anya P.: Thanks — which endpoint and region?
Sam K.: /v1/generate in eu-west-1, customer says p95 latency spiked to 12s then saw 502s. Happened across a handful of tenants.
Kevin L.: Looking at runner telemetry — we see a burst of pending queue + upstream read timeouts on the edge proxy around 09:39:50.
Marta O.: Assigning myself to triage. Can someone drop a repro curl and a log snippet here? :eyes:
Ravi S.: Repro curl I used from support: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"test"}' \
  https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Sam K.: Support captured customer stack traces, attached excerpt: 
```
2026-03-15T09:39:52Z proxy: upstream read timeout (host=gateway-3)
2026-03-15T09:39:53Z auth-proxy: token refresh 502 from idp (502 Bad Gateway)
2026-03-15T09:39:53Z handler: request queued (queue_len=48)\n```
Anya P.: Auth proxy 502s could cascade into queue growth. Any recent deploys to auth or edge?
Kevin L.: No deploys to auth service in last 8h. There was a routing change to reduce cross-zone egress at 07:00 but that was reverted at 08:20.
Marta O.: Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route eu-west traffic to fallback auth cluster (manual route) 2) increase gateway connection pool/timeout 3) enable aggressive circuit-breaker to fail fast to Dedicated fallback.
Sam K.: Implementing #1 now — EngOps Bot: please apply route tag `eu-auth-fallback` to edge pools and confirm.
EngOps Bot: route applied to pool eu-west-auth-fallback, confirmation id: r-8923.
Ravi S.: After route flip we saw 502s drop immediately but p95 still at ~3s for a few minutes while queues drained.
Anya P.: Good. Next steps for postmortem: capture timeline, root cause check (auth idp flakiness vs gateway read timeout), reproduce with load test, and improved rollback/runbook.
Marta O.: Action items (owners):
- Auth team: dig into IDP 502 traces and token refresh error patterns (owner: Anya P.)
- Gateway: review keepalive and upstream timeout defaults; propose config patch (owner: Kevin L.)
- Batching/runtime: ensure graceful degradation path to compact model variants (owner: Ravi S.)
- Support: customer comms + credit review (owner: Sam K.)
- EngOps: automate fallback route and add a one-click in console (owner: Marta O.)
Sam K.: ETA for initial RCA doc? Can we have a draft in 24h for customer comms?
Anya P.: Yes — I'll start a timeline + evidence doc and drop link here within 6h.
Kevin L.: I'll prototype gateway config changes in staging and run focused e2e by EOD.
Ravi S.: I'll run a local replay of the customer's traffic to validate queue behavior and KV cache pressure.
Marta O.: Scheduling postmortem review + pager rotation check tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll create the calendar invite.
Support Bot: Incident marker added: severity=sev2, incident_id=INC-20260315-022.
Sam K.: Thanks team. I'll update the customer with temporary mitigation summary and ETA for RCA. :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: Quick note — include logs showing token refresh 502 timings, looks like bursts of 100ms->800ms before 502, might indicate IDP rate-limited connection pool.
Anya P.: Noted. We should also add an alert for auth 5xx rate > 5% in 5m and queue length > 40 for gateway.
Ravi S.: Adding those alerts to our runbook after we confirm thresholds.
Marta O.: Closing for now — we'll reconvene on the postmortem thread once docs are live. If anything regresses ping #oncall immediately.
Sam K.: Closing the support escalation ticket after customer ack. Good work everyone.
